name: Entegris
outlook:
What Entegris says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: salesFor the Company’s guidance for the fourth quarter ending December 31, 2026, the Company expects sales of $1,025 million to $1,055 million.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: GAAP net income and earnings per shareThe Company expects GAAP net income to be between $168 million and $181 million and diluted earnings per common share is expected to be between $1.09 and $1.17.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: non-GAAP earnings per shareOn a non-GAAP basis, the Company expects diluted earnings per common share to range from $1.32 to $1.40, reflecting net income on a non-GAAP basis in the range of $203 million to $215 million.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EBITDAThe Company also expects Adjusted EBITDA of approximately 30.7% to 31.2% of sales.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
